title: Frog waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='26' ry='22' fill='#3ec94a'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='18' ry='15' fill='#b8f26a'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='40' rx='24' ry='20' fill='#3ec94a'/>
  <!-- eye bulges -->
  <circle cx='33' cy='26' r='11' fill='#3ec94a'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='26' r='11' fill='#3ec94a'/>
  <!-- eyes white -->
  <circle cx='33' cy='26' r='8' fill='#fff9d6'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='26' r='8' fill='#fff9d6'/>
  <!-- pupils -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='27' r='4' fill='#1f3a7a'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='27' r='4' fill='#1f3a7a'/>
  <!-- sparkle -->
  <circle cx='35.5' cy='25' r='1.4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='67.5' cy='25' r='1.4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M36 48 Q50 60 64 48' stroke='#1f6b2e' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='44' r='4' fill='#ff9ec4'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='44' r='4' fill='#ff9ec4'/>
  <!-- left arm down -->
  <path d='M28 66 Q16 72 14 82' stroke='#3ec94a' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='13' cy='84' r='4.5' fill='#3ec94a'/>
  <!-- right arm waving up -->
  <path d='M72 62 Q86 52 88 34' stroke='#3ec94a' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- waving hand -->
  <circle cx='88' cy='30' r='7' fill='#3ec94a'/>
  <path d='M83 27 L82 20' stroke='#3ec94a' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M88 25 L88 17' stroke='#3ec94a' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M93 27 L94 20' stroke='#3ec94a' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='89' rx='10' ry='5' fill='#2aa838'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='89' rx='10' ry='5' fill='#2aa838'/>
</svg>
